user_story: As a user, I want to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs on the page so that I can see the alerts and confirm or prompt actions. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', a JavaScript alert should appear. 2. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', a JavaScript confirm dialog should appear. 3. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Prompt', a JavaScript prompt dialog should appear. 4. The element with id 'result' should be present on the page.
